startDescription: One link. Everyone chooses their favourites. One order from Nordic Eatery.
hostDescription: You pay for the entire group at checkout.
splitDescription: Everyone pays for their own dishes.
linkPrivacy: Anyone with the link can join and see the group's names and dishes. Share it only with your guests. Your session stays in this browser.
lockExplanation: Locking stops changes and confirms current menu prices. Review the total before paying.
waitingReady: Everyone must finish choosing before checkout.
joinDescription: Enter your name, choose your dishes and mark yourself ready. Everyone in the group can see your name and selections.
orderPlacedDescription: The kitchen has received your group order.
oneOrder: Everyone's dishes will be prepared as one order.
refundExplanation: Completed payments are automatically sent for refund. Your bank may take several days to return the funds. Contact us if a refund remains pending.
splitPaymentExplanation: The cart is locked. Each person pays their own share. We send the order to the kitchen once everyone has paid.
hostPaymentExplanation: The cart is locked. The organiser pays for the entire order.
paidWaiting: Your payment is confirmed. Waiting for the group to finish paying.
paymentSafety: Card payments use Stripe; Swish payments use Swish. Payment must complete within 60 minutes. Paid shares are refunded if the group is cancelled.
readyExplanation: You're ready. You can edit your selection until the organiser locks the order or the deadline passes.
selectionExplanation: Add your dishes below, leave any notes, then select “I'm done”.
deadlineExplanation: Choosing has ended. The organiser can check out or remove guests who are not ready.
selectLink: Select and copy the link above.
cancelConfirmation: Cancel for everyone? Any completed payments will be refunded.

kitchen.new: The kitchen has received your order.
kitchen.cancelled: The restaurant cancelled this order. Contact us for assistance.

errors.unavailable: Group ordering is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.invalidDeadline: Choose a future deadline within 24 hours.
errors.unauthorized: Join the group in this browser first.
errors.hostOnly: Only the organiser can do this.
errors.locked: The order is locked. Refresh to see its current status.
errors.deadlinePassed: The time for choosing has ended.
errors.conflict: The group changed. Review the latest basket and try again.
errors.productUnavailable: A dish is unavailable or there is not enough stock. Adjust the basket.
errors.spendLimitExceeded: This exceeds the spending limit per person.
errors.orderTooLarge: This order is too large. Please contact us for catering.
errors.membersNotReady: Wait for everyone to finish choosing.
errors.minimumPayment: Each card payment must be at least 3 SEK.
errors.kitchenClosed: The kitchen is closed. You cannot check out yet.
errors.optionUnavailable: This payment or delivery option is currently unavailable.
errors.alreadyReady: Select “Edit my selection” before changing dishes.
errors.alreadySubmitted: The order has already been sent to the kitchen.
errors.paymentExpired: Payment time ended. The group will be cancelled and paid shares refunded.
errors.alreadyPaid: Your share has already been paid.
errors.paymentPending: Payment is being confirmed. Please wait.
errors.paymentMismatch: Payment could not be verified. Contact the restaurant.
errors.paymentNeedsReview: Payment needs review. Contact the restaurant before trying again.
errors.refundNeedsReview: Your order is cancelled, but a refund needs help. Contact the restaurant.
errors.invalidPhone: Enter the Swedish phone number connected to Swish.

swishPending: Open Swish on the phone connected to this number and approve the request. This page updates when payment is confirmed.
cashExplanation: Confirm that you will pay when collecting the order. No money is charged now.
cashWaiting: Confirmed. Waiting for the remaining participants.
cashSubmitted: Payment is due on site. This order has not been marked as paid.
